topNews.headline: Oil shock: Brent tops $100 after Houthi strikes on two Saudi tankers
topNews.actionable: The single biggest cross-portfolio driver — bullish oil/energy + Seatrium and a metals safe-haven bid, but it revives the inflation impulse that keeps the Fed/MAS hawkish (headwind for HK tech, S-REITs, levered silver). Trade the de-escalation risk.

topNews.actionable: Riding a genuine rebound into a hawkish-Fed catalyst and toppy positioning — trim leverage/harvest, don't add; gold's real-yield sensitivity is the warning, $58 silver the line to hold.
